lang.label: Page language
hero.title: Any article from the internet — on the screen of your e-reader
hero.lead: Open this site in the e-reader’s browser and scan the code with your phone. The phone does the rest: it turns the page into reader mode and sends it to the e-reader, and the e-reader lays the text out screen by screen and remembers where you stopped.
hero.fact1: Nothing is installed on the e-reader — only its browser is needed
hero.fact2: Articles and reading progress are stored on your phone
ereader.title: Reader mode
ereader.scan: Scan this code with your phone
qr.label: QR code for the phone. Open it full screen
stage.caption: This is what the e-reader’s screen looks like. The code is real: tap it, and it opens full screen. Go back with the “Back” button or the Esc key.
how.title: How it works
how.lead: The e-reader gets articles straight from your phone — without cables, e-mail or converters.
how.1.title: Open the site on the e-reader
how.1.text: Open this site’s address in the e-reader’s browser. A QR code appears on the screen: the e-reader is waiting for the phone.
how.2.title: Scan the code with your phone
how.2.text: The camera opens the app on the phone. You can install it on the home screen and send links to it through the “Share” menu.
how.3.title: Send articles
how.3.text: Add a link and tap the article — it opens on the e-reader from the place where you stopped. Turn pages with buttons or a gesture.
features.title: Made for e-ink
features.1.title: Reader mode for any page
features.1.text: The Readability algorithm from Firefox removes menus, ads and pop-ups — text and pictures remain.
features.2.title: Pages that fit the screen exactly
features.2.text: No scrolling and no cut lines, with hyphenation and justified text. A picture moves to the next screen as a whole.
features.3.title: Your reading place is not lost
features.3.text: The e-reader tells the phone where you stopped, and next time the article opens in the same place — even on another e-reader.
features.4.title: Opens without a network
features.4.text: The e-reader page is saved in its browser (where there is a service worker): while Wi‑Fi comes up, it is already on the screen and waits for the connection by itself.
features.5.title: For any e-reader
features.5.text: Screen rotation, page turns with buttons or a gesture, font size and style, line spacing, Russian and English.
features.6.title: Links in an article
features.6.text: A link can be opened on the e-reader as a new article, sent to the phone as a notification, or opened right in the e-reader’s browser.
privacy.title: Your articles stay with you
privacy.1: The article list, their text and your reading progress are stored only in your phone’s browser.
privacy.2: The server remembers one last message of each side, and only in memory: after a restart it remembers nothing.
privacy.3: The server does not download pages from internal networks and does not write session identifiers or article addresses to its log.
